items.sentence: The flood was an act of god.
items.translation: 那场洪水是天灾（不可抗力）。
explanations: **act of god** 法律/保险术语，指超出人类控制的自然灾害（地震、洪水、台风等）。常见于合同免责条款。
近义表达：force majeure（法律法语词）/ natural disaster（自然灾害）。例句：The damage was caused by an act of god, not by our negligence.

sentenceAudio.text: The flood was an act of god.

items.sentence: He repeated the joke ad nauseam.
items.translation: 他一遍又一遍地讲那个笑话，说得让人烦死了。
hints: 没完没了地（令人厌烦地）

grammar.meaning: 没完没了地、令人厌烦地

explanations: **ad nauseam** 拉丁语（= to nausea「到令人作呕」），表示重复到让人厌烦。常用来吐槽某人反复说同一件事。
口语近义：over and over / a million times。变体：ad infinitum（无穷无尽地）。例句：She explained the rules ad nauseam until everyone zoned out.

sentenceAudio.text: He repeated the joke ad nauseam.

items.sentence: My boss is all bark no bite.
items.translation: 我老板只是嘴上厉害，从不动真格的。
explanations: **all bark no bite** 形容人/动物只是嘴硬、威胁多但不会真正行动。对应中文「光打雷不下雨」「嘴硬心软」。
常用来评价严厉但从不动手的上司/老师。近义：all hat, no cattle（牛仔版）/ a paper tiger（纸老虎，毛泽东用法）。

sentenceAudio.text: My boss is all bark no bite.

items.sentence: Something seems amiss here.
items.translation: 这里好像有点不对劲。
explanations: **amiss** 形容词，意思是不对劲、出故障。常用于 something is/seems amiss 句型，"What's amiss?"（出了啥事？）。
源自古英语，常见搭配：nothing amiss（一切正常）/ there's something amiss（哪里不对劲）。英式口语常用。

sentenceAudio.text: Something seems amiss here.

items.sentence: I want peace and all that.
items.translation: 我就想要平静之类的。

grammar.meaning: 以及所有那些（和类似的事）

explanations: **and all that** 口语中的含糊补语，表示「以及类似的事情/和那些」，用来轻描淡写、不想细说。常配合耸肩。
近义：and stuff (like that) / or something。例句：I'm just tired and all that — I need to crash. 注意：偏随意，邮件中慎用。

sentenceAudio.text: I want peace and all that.

items.sentence: She's a teacher at heart.
items.translation: 她骨子里是个老师。
explanations: **at heart** 强调人的真实本性或核心身份，不管外在表现如何。常用来评价人或自我评价。
近义：at the core / deep down / essentially。例句：He's a banker at heart, even now that he's retired.

sentenceAudio.text: She's a teacher at heart.

items.sentence: Sorry I'm late — better late than never!
items.translation: 抱歉来晚了——迟到总比不到好！
explanations: **Better late than never.** 谚语「迟到总比不到好」，用来安慰晚到的成果/回应。中国谚语「亡羊补牢」也是类似安慰但侧重补救。
口语中常用 self-deprecating 方式自嘲迟到的回复。结构：better + 比较级 + than + 反义基准。变体：better safe than sorry（谨慎总比后悔好）。

sentenceAudio.text: Sorry I'm late — better late than never!

items.sentence: Birds of a feather flock together.
items.translation: 物以类聚，人以群分。
explanations: **Birds of a feather (flock together)** 谚语「物以类聚，人以群分」。常用来评价一群朋友/同事/伴侣的相似性，可褒可贬。
口语中常省略后半，说 "Birds of a feather..." 对方就能接上。变体：like attracts like（同类相吸）。注意：语气带 judgment，用时看清场合。

sentenceAudio.text: Birds of a feather flock together.

items.sentence: Bring your A game tomorrow.
items.translation: 明天拿出你最好的表现。
explanations: **A game** 源自美国体育（A 级表现即最佳水平），现泛指任何领域的最佳状态。常用 bring/show A game。
近义：bring your best / step up your game / be on your A game（处于 A 状态）。例句：You've got to bring your A game to this interview.

sentenceAudio.text: Bring your A game tomorrow.

items.sentence: I passed by the skin of my teeth.
items.translation: 我侥幸通过了，差一点就没过。
chunks: I passed by the skin of my teeth.
hints: 我侥幸通过了，差一点就没过。

grammar.meaning: 我侥幸通过了，差一点就没过

explanations: **by the skin of one's teeth** 源自《圣经·约伯记》19:20，字面「只剩牙齿的皮」，意为险些失败、堪堪躲过。
近义：narrowly / barely / by a hair's breadth（差一根头发）。注意 teeth 是复数，"skin of my teeth" 不能换成 tooth。例句：We caught the flight by the skin of our teeth.

sentenceAudio.text: I passed by the skin of my teeth.

items.sentence: You're joking — come off it!
items.translation: 你在开玩笑——别扯了!
explanations: **come off it** 短语动词祈使句，意为「别装了/收起你的鬼话/别闹了」。朋友间常用，对夸张说法表达不信。
近义：come on / give me a break / you've got to be kidding。例句：— I never lost a game. — Come off it!

sentenceAudio.text: You're joking — come off it!

items.sentence: I think he's coming on to you.
items.translation: 我觉得他在撩你。
explanations: **come on to (someone)** 短语动词，意为（对某人）调情、示好、暧昧。多指单方面主动接近，常带暗示意味。
注意与 come on（加油/快点/得了吧）区分。例句：He kept coming on to me at the party, so I left.

sentenceAudio.text: I think he's coming on to you.

items.sentence: I've been a couch potato all weekend.
items.translation: 我整个周末都窝在沙发上看电视。

grammar.meaning: 整天躺沙发看电视的人

explanations: **couch potato** 俚语，形容整天窝在沙发上看电视/刷手机、几乎不下床的人。贬义，带轻微自嘲意味。
近义：homebody（宅家者，偏中性）/ shut-in（闭门不出，偏严重）。变体 veggie（蔬菜=沙发土豆的简短称呼）。例句：Stop being a couch potato — let's go for a walk.

sentenceAudio.text: I've been a couch potato all weekend.

items.sentence: Don't give yourself airs.
items.translation: 别摆架子。
explanations: **give oneself airs** 固定短语，意为摆架子、装腔作势、装了不起。多用于批评。airs 是复数名词，不能写成 air。
近义：put on airs（更常用）/ act high and mighty / get a big head（自大）。例句：He really gives himself airs since he got promoted.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't give yourself airs.

items.sentence: Fake it until you make it.
items.translation: 先装作能行，直到真的做到。
explanations: **Fake it until you make it.** 励志谚语，强调先假装自信/熟练，直到真正掌握。美国心理学 Amy Cuddy 的 power posing 理论也基于此。
口语常用，注意语气：可激励人也可能暗示冒牌货。注意 make it 意为「做成」；it 重复指上文整件事。变体：Fake it till you make it（till 比 until 更口语）。

sentenceAudio.text: Fake it until you make it.

items.sentence: That's a fresh take.
items.translation: 这是个新颖的视角。
explanations: **fresh take** 名词短语，指对事情的新颖视角、独特观点。常用于评价观点/表演/方案与之前不同。
口语常用：That's a fresh take on the problem. 注意与 fresh（清新/新鲜）单独使用区分。变体：a new spin on / a different angle on。

sentenceAudio.text: That's a fresh take.

items.sentence: Try not to overthink; go with the flow.
items.translation: 别想太多；顺其自然就好。
explanations: **go with the flow** 短语动词，意为随大流、随遇而安、不强行控制局面。褒贬随语境——可指适应性强，也可指没主见。
近义：roll with the punches（拳击习语，更口语）/ take things as they come。注意与 go with the times（与时俱进）区分。例句：Just relax and go with the flow.

sentenceAudio.text: Try not to overthink; go with the flow.

items.sentence: She's going it alone this time.
items.translation: 这次她要独自扛。
explanations: **go it alone** 短语动词，意为独自行动、单干。常用来评价独立创业者/决策者。it 是形式宾语，指代正在做的事。
近义：go solo / strike out on one's own。注意语境：从「独立勇敢」到「孤立无援」都适用，看动词时态和上下文。

sentenceAudio.text: She's going it alone this time.

items.sentence: Hang in there — it'll get better.
items.translation: 再坚持一下——会好起来的。
explanations: **hang in there** 短语动词，意为坚持下去、不放弃。常用于安慰处于困境/低谷的人。比 stick with it 更口语、更有共情。
近义：keep at it / stay strong / don't give up。例句：I know the job is tough, but hang in there. 注意：hang in 不带 there 时意为「凑合着用」。

sentenceAudio.text: Hang in there — it'll get better.

items.sentence: He holds a grudge like nobody's business.
items.translation: 他记仇记得没完没了。

grammar.pos: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）

explanations: **like nobody's business** 程度状语，意为「不得了」「不一般地」，形容程度夸张。比 very 更有戏谑色彩。
近义：like crazy / like mad / like it's going out of style（也过时）。例句：She can cook like nobody's business. 注意 nobody's 永远带撇号。

sentenceAudio.text: He holds a grudge like nobody's business.

items.sentence: Let it be; don't force it.
items.translation: 顺其自然吧；别强求。
explanations: **let it be** 短语动词，意为听其自然、不强行干预。也是披头士名曲《Let It Be》歌名。隐含一种禅意/接受情绪。
与 let it go（放下，源自《冰雪奇缘》Frozen）近义但侧重不同：let it be 是接受现状，let it go 是释怀过去。例句：Things will work themselves out — just let it be.

sentenceAudio.text: Let it be; don't force it.

items.sentence: Make yourself at home.
items.translation: 别客气，像在自己家一样。
hints: 别拘束，像在自己家一样自在
explanations: **make yourself at home** 标准客人招待用语，让对方自在不拘束。多用于请客人坐下/喝茶前。
近义：feel free / make yourself comfortable。注意 yourself 不能换成其他代词（you 含反身意义）。例句：Welcome! Please come in and make yourself at home.

sentenceAudio.text: Make yourself at home.

items.sentence: No need to make a fuss.
items.translation: 不用这么大惊小怪。
explanations: **make a fuss** 短语动词，意为小题大做、大惊小怪、过分激动。可加 over 某人/某事：make a fuss over nothing。
近义：make a big deal / kick up a fuss（更强烈）/ hit the ceiling/freak out（情绪化）。例句：Don't make a fuss — it's just a scratch.

sentenceAudio.text: No need to make a fuss.

items.sentence: Once in a blue moon, I eat fast food.
items.translation: 我难得吃一次快餐。
explanations: **once in a blue moon** 频率状语，意为「难得一次」「极为罕见」（蓝色月亮 ≈ 每 2-3 年才出现一次的天文现象）。
近义：every once in a while（更频繁）/ hardly ever / not often。反义：every now and then / frequently。注意 blue moon 是固定搭配，不能换成别的颜色。

sentenceAudio.text: Once in a blue moon, I eat fast food.

items.sentence: Pull yourself together.
items.translation: 振作起来。

grammar.meaning: 让自己振作或冷静下来

explanations: **pull yourself together** 短语动词，意为控制情绪、振作、冷静下来。常对崩溃/慌乱/情绪失控的人说。
近义：get a grip（自己）/ compose yourself / settle down。更柔和的版本：take a deep breath。注意是对受话人说，you 永远是 yourself。

sentenceAudio.text: Pull yourself together.

items.sentence: She has a sweet tooth.
items.translation: 她爱吃甜食。
explanations: **sweet tooth** 名词短语，字面「甜牙」，指爱吃甜食/糖果的喜好。口语且带亲昵感，形容自己时多带自嘲。
近义：sugar addict / chocoholic（巧克力成瘾者）。复数：sweet teeth。常说：I have a sweet tooth — pass the cake.

sentenceAudio.text: She has a sweet tooth.

items.sentence: Take it with a grain of salt.
items.translation: 半信半疑地听。
explanations: **with a grain of salt** 来源古罗马毒物解药配方（一粒盐），意为不全信、保留怀疑。听八卦/广告/单一来源消息时常用。
近义：with a pinch of salt（更轻微）/ take it with a dose of skepticism。变体：take everything with a grain of salt。注意：别写成 "a grain of sugar"。

sentenceAudio.text: Take it with a grain of salt.

items.sentence: We're on the same page.
items.translation: 我们意见一致。
explanations: **on the same page** 固定短语，意为理解一致、意见统一，源自工作汇报/会议场景。也可指「在同一进度上」。
近义：in agreement / on the same wavelength。 反义：on different pages（沟通错位）。常用回应：Let's make sure we're on the same page before we move on.

sentenceAudio.text: We're on the same page.

items.sentence: You are what you eat.
items.translation: 人如其食：饮食会影响人的健康与状态。
hints: 人如其食：饮食会影响人的健康与状态。

grammar.meaning: 人如其食：饮食会影响人的健康与状态

explanations: **You are what you eat.** 谚语，强调饮食对健康/状态/性格的影响。常用于健康饮食倡导场合。
也可比喻思想/习惯塑造人：You are what you read. 你读什么就是什么人。字面对比：You are what you drink（Drake 歌曲名）。

sentenceAudio.text: You are what you eat.

items.sentence: They keep up with the Joneses by buying a new car every year.
items.translation: 他们年年换新车，就为跟邻居攀比。
chunks: by buying a new car every year.
explanations: **keep up with the Joneses** 指在物质消费上「攀比邻居、不甘落后」。源自 1913 年美国连环画《Keeping Up with the Joneses》，Joneses 泛指虚构的富裕邻居。
近义：keep pace with（跟上节奏）；反义：do your own thing（走自己的路）。口语里常带贬义：Buying a bigger TV is just keeping up with the Joneses.
distractors: to buy a new car every year.

sentenceAudio.text: They keep up with the Joneses by buying a new car every year.

items.sentence: We're young, so let's live it up this summer.
items.translation: 我们还年轻，今年夏天就尽情狂欢吧。
explanations: **live it up** 非正式口语，指「纵情享受、过奢华痛快的日子」，常见于假期、派对、发工资等语境。it 指代『生活本身』，无实指。
近义：have a blast（玩得尽兴）/ let loose（放松）。例：You just got promoted — go live it up tonight!

sentenceAudio.text: We're young, so let's live it up this summer.

items.sentence: She works two jobs to make ends meet.
items.translation: 她打两份工才能勉强维持生计。
explanations: **make ends meet** 常用习语：收入仅够开销、「勉强糊口」。ends 指账本的两端（收入/支出），把两端接上=收支平衡。
例：With rent so high, many young people can barely make ends meet.（房租这么高，很多年轻人入不敷出。）近义：get by（勉强过活）。

sentenceAudio.text: She works two jobs to make ends meet.

items.sentence: Money talks — he got the contract overnight.
items.translation: 有钱能使鬼推磨——他隔夜就拿下了合同。
hints: 金钱说了算（有钱能使鬼推磨）
explanations: **Money talks** 谚语：金钱有话语权，「有钱能使鬼推磨」。talk 拟人化——钱会替你『说话』、开路。
变体：Money talks, bullshit walks.（真金白银说话，空话走人——较粗，慎用正式场合。）近义：Money makes the world go round.

sentenceAudio.text: Money talks — he got the contract overnight.

items.sentence: The coach gave the team a pep talk before the final.
items.translation: 决赛前教练给全队做了一番鼓舞士气的动员。
explanations: **pep talk**：赛前/任务前的简短「动员讲话」，目的是提气。pep 意为精力、活力（pep up 使振作）。常见于体育、销售、考前场景。
动词搭配：give sb a pep talk / need a pep talk。例：My manager gave me a pep talk before the presentation.（演讲前经理给我打气。）
distractors: The coach had given the team

sentenceAudio.text: The coach gave the team a pep talk before the final.

items.sentence: Don't worry, you'll be right as rain after a good sleep.
items.translation: 别担心，好好睡一觉你就会完全恢复的。
explanations: **right as rain** 英式色彩浓的习语，表示「完全正常、状态极佳、恢复如初」。rain 押韵且表清爽/滋养，故用 rain 而非其他词。
常接在 be/feel 后：I'll be right as rain tomorrow.（我明天就活蹦乱跳了。）近义：as good as new / fit as a fiddle。

sentenceAudio.text: Don't worry, you'll be right as rain after a good sleep.

items.sentence: His loud voice rubbed me the wrong way.
items.translation: 他大嗓门让我心里很不舒服。
explanations: **rub sb the wrong way**：无意间「惹恼、使不快」。意象：顺着毛摸（rub the right way）让人舒服，逆着毛（the wrong way）就难受。
第三人称注意人称：His attitude rubs ME the wrong way / rubs HER the wrong way。近义：get on sb's nerves（让人烦躁）。

sentenceAudio.text: His loud voice rubbed me the wrong way.

items.sentence: Sorry I'm late — that's on me.
items.translation: 抱歉我来晚了——是我的错。
explanations: **That's on me.** 美式口语：主动揽责——「这是我的错/责任」。on sb = 责任落在某人身上。同级还有 The fault is on me. 语义更强。
用法区分：That's on me.（揽责）/ It's on me.（这顿我请客——同形不同义，靠语境）。近义：my bad / I take the blame.

sentenceAudio.text: Sorry I'm late — that's on me.

items.sentence: Think it over before you quit your job.
items.translation: 辞职之前，好好考虑一下。
explanations: **think it over**：花时间「仔细考虑、权衡」后再决定。代词 it 必须放中间：think it over / think things over，不能说 think over it。
近义：sleep on it（睡一觉再决定，缓一夜）。例：Don't rush — think it over and call me tomorrow.

sentenceAudio.text: Think it over before you quit your job.

items.sentence: Ask Tom for advice — he really knows his stuff.
items.translation: 去请教汤姆吧——他对这行是真懂。
explanations: **know one's stuff**：对自己的领域「非常在行、门儿清」。stuff 泛指业务内容。搭配 one's 随主语变化：know your stuff / know my stuff。
近义：know one's onions（英式）/ be an expert。例：She's young but she knows her stuff when it comes to coding.

sentenceAudio.text: Ask Tom for advice — he really knows his stuff.

items.sentence: He ignored the warning and got burned — he asked for it.
items.translation: 他不听警告栽了跟头——这是他自找的。
explanations: **ask for it**：字面『讨要』，实际指『自找麻烦、咎由自取』，常因不听劝告而吃亏。过去式 asked for it。
较直白版：You asked for trouble. 例：He drove drunk and crashed — he really asked for it.（酒驾出车祸，纯属自找。）

sentenceAudio.text: He ignored the warning and got burned — he asked for it.

items.sentence: Don't get me wrong — I like the city, I just miss the quiet.
items.translation: 别误会——我喜欢这座城市，只是想念那份清静。
explanations: **Don't get me wrong**：说容易引起误解的话之前的「预防针」——别把我的意思理解偏了。get = 理解，wrong = 错误地。
固定句式：Don't get me wrong, + 想说的内容。例：Don't get me wrong, he's nice — he's just not very reliable.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't get me wrong — I like the city, I just miss the quiet.

items.sentence: We're in a hurry, so get to the point.
items.translation: 我们赶时间，请直接说重点。
explanations: **get to the point**：说话「直奔要点」，别绕弯子。point = 核心观点。是会议、争论中的高频祈使表达。
反义：beat around the bush（拐弯抹角）。例：Stop the small talk and get to the point — what's the price?

sentenceAudio.text: We're in a hurry, so get to the point.

items.sentence: The boys wrecked the garden again — boys will be boys.
items.translation: 那些男孩又把花园弄乱了——男孩嘛，本性难移。
chunks: The boys wrecked the garden again
hints: 男孩就是男孩（天性如此，别太计较）
explanations: **Boys will be boys.** 西方谚语：男孩淘气是天性，用来为顽皮/幼稚行为开脱。语气通常是宽容的摇头一笑。
中性批评者会指它是在『为不当行为找借口』。现代口语也出现 girls will be girls 的玩笑用法。
distractors: The boys cleaned the garden again
The kids wrecked the garden again
The boy wrecked the garden again

sentenceAudio.text: The boys wrecked the garden again — boys will be boys.

items.sentence: The broken printer was the last straw — I quit.
items.translation: 打印机坏掉成了压垮我的最后一根稻草——我辞职了。
chunks: The broken printer was the last straw
hints: 坏掉的打印机是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草

grammar.meaning: 坏打印机成了最后一根稻草

explanations: **the last straw**：缩写自 the last straw that breaks the camel's back（压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草）——一系列忍让后最终引爆的那件事。
例：The rude email was the last straw.（那封无礼的邮件成了压垮我的最后一根稻草。）近义：the final blow / the breaking point.
distractors: The missing file was the last straw
The slow computer was the last straw
The broken printer was the tip of the iceberg

sentenceAudio.text: The broken printer was the last straw — I quit.

items.sentence: Enough is enough — stop making excuses.
items.translation: 适可而止吧——别再找借口了。
hints: 够了就是够了（我已经受够了）
explanations: **Enough is enough.** 语气强硬：容忍到极限，「适可而止、我受够了」。以同词重复构成强调，常用于吵架/警告的收尾。
变体：I've had enough.（我受够了。）例：Enough is enough — we're returning this defective product.

sentenceAudio.text: Enough is enough — stop making excuses.

items.sentence: You pay for the dinner and I'll cover the movie — call it even.
items.translation: 你出晚饭钱，电影票我来付——咱俩算扯平。
explanations: **call it even**：把账算平、「互不相欠」。even = 对等。常出现在轮流请客、分工后：You got the first round, I'll get this one and we call it even.
近义：be even / we're square / call it quits（就此打住，可指关系或争执）。例：I helped you move; you fixed my bike — let's call it even.

sentenceAudio.text: You pay for the dinner and I'll cover the movie — call it even.

items.sentence: Sorry to bother you, but do you have a minute?
items.translation: 抱歉打扰一下，你有空吗？
chunks: but do you have a minute?
explanations: **Sorry to bother you** 职场/日常万能开场白：礼貌地打断别人。bother = 打扰、添麻烦。回答：No problem / Not at all.
变体：Sorry to interrupt（打断别人说话时）/ Sorry for the trouble（事后致歉）。同义礼貌开场：Excuse me, do you have a second?
distractors: but do you have the time?
but do you have a pen?
but are you in a hurry?

sentenceAudio.text: Sorry to bother you, but do you have a minute?

items.sentence: If you love the job, just go for it.
items.translation: 你要是喜欢这份工作，就大胆去争取吧。
explanations: **go for it** 万能鼓励语：放手去做、勇敢争取、别犹豫。it 指代目标/机会。比 try it 更带冲劲。
例：— Should I apply for the manager position? — Of course, go for it! 近义：give it a shot / just do it.

sentenceAudio.text: If you love the job, just go for it.

items.sentence: There are only five seats — it's first come, first served.
items.translation: 只有五个座位——先到先得。
explanations: **First come, first served.** 通用规则语：按到达顺序先到先得。served 严格语法应为被动 served，口语常说 serve。常见于售票、入场、抢座。
例：The free samples are first come, first served.（免费试吃先到先得。）祈使变体：First come, first serve!（招牌常用，语法略省。）

sentenceAudio.text: There are only five seats — it's first come, first served.

items.sentence: It's only a matter of time before the truth comes out.
items.translation: 真相大白只是时间问题。
chunks: It's only a matter of time
explanations: **a matter of time**：某事必然发生，「只是早晚问题」。固定句式 It's only/just a matter of time before + 从句。
例：It's only a matter of time before they find out.（他们发现只是时间问题。）近义：it's inevitable / it's bound to happen.
distractors: It's not a matter of time
It's only a matter of days
It's only a matter of money

sentenceAudio.text: It's only a matter of time before the truth comes out.

items.sentence: Where we eat tonight is up to you.
items.translation: 今晚去哪吃，由你决定。
explanations: **up to you**：决定权交给你——「由你决定/看你」。固定搭配 it's up to you / it's up to sb。口语常单独成句：Up to you!
变体：It's your call.（你来拍板。）例：— Movie or dinner? — Up to you, I'm easy.（你定吧，我都行。）

sentenceAudio.text: Where we eat tonight is up to you.

items.sentence: The car almost hit me — that was close!
items.translation: 那辆车差点撞上我——好险！
explanations: **That was close!** 劫后余生的感叹：差一点就出事/成功，「好险！/就差一点！」。close = 接近（危险或成败边缘）。
也用于体育、比赛险胜：That was close — we won by one point! 近义：That was a narrow escape.

sentenceAudio.text: The car almost hit me — that was close!

items.sentence: Keep your chin up — better days are coming.
items.translation: 抬起头来别气馁——好日子会来的。
explanations: **keep your chin up** 安慰语：别垂头丧气、保持乐观。意象：下巴抬起来=不低头认输。常在朋友失意时说。
例：I know the interview went badly, but keep your chin up — there will be other chances. 近义：cheer up / stay positive.

sentenceAudio.text: Keep your chin up — better days are coming.

items.sentence: I won't sign that contract — no way!
items.translation: 我绝不签那份合同——没门！
explanations: **No way!** 强烈拒绝/惊讶：不可能！没门！比 No 更口语、带情绪。
近义：No! / Absolutely not! / Forget it! 例：— Want to skydive? — No way!

sentenceAudio.text: I won't sign that contract — no way!

items.sentence: Come on, the bus is almost here!
items.translation: 快点，公交车快到了！
explanations: **Come on** 催促/不耐烦/鼓励：快点！加把劲！语境：催人出门、加好友游戏、鼓励沮丧的人。
注意连读：come on = /kʌm ɑːn/。也用在句末：Oh, come on!（哎，别这样！）

sentenceAudio.text: Come on, the bus is almost here!

items.sentence: Hold on a second — I'll get the door.
items.translation: 稍等一下——我去开门。
explanations: **hold on** 等一下；Hold on a second 句式：稍等一会儿。比 wait 口语、电话常用。
近义：wait a moment / hang on（同义）/ just a sec. 例：— Is this the right bus? — Hold on, let me check.

sentenceAudio.text: Hold on a second — I'll get the door.

items.sentence: Hold it — I need to check this first.
items.translation: 暂停一下——我得先核实这件事。
chunks: I need to check this first.
explanations: **Hold it** 比 hold on 更强烈：暂停！停一下！多在对方行动过快、过急时叫停。
近义：Hold on / Wait a minute / Easy now. 例：— I'll spend $5000. — Hold it — we can't afford that.
distractors: I need to fix this first.
I need to check that first.
I want to check this first.

sentenceAudio.text: Hold it — I need to check this first.

items.sentence: You're in my personal space — back off!
items.translation: 你靠得太近了——退后！
hints: 你侵犯了我的私人空间
explanations: **Back off** 命令对方后撤/退让：退后！别再逼近。多用于争吵、肢体冲突升级时。
近义：Step back / Move away. 名词形式：give someone some space.

sentenceAudio.text: You're in my personal space — back off!

items.sentence: Cheer up — things will get better.
items.translation: 振作起来——事情会好起来的。
explanations: **Cheer up** 鼓励沮丧的人：振作起来。up = 向上=情绪好转。
近义：keep your chin up / hang in there / stay positive. 例：I failed the exam. — Don't worry, cheer up, you can try again.

sentenceAudio.text: Cheer up — things will get better.

items.sentence: I don't want to see you — get lost!
items.translation: 我不想见到你——滚开！
chunks: I don't want to see you —
explanations: **Get lost** 粗鲁命令走开：滚开、消失。lost = 迷路=请消失在我视野里。
注意语气强烈，比 go away 更狠。例：— Can I borrow $100? — Get lost! Get a job!
distractors: I don't want to talk to you —
I don't want to hear you —

sentenceAudio.text: I don't want to see you — get lost!

items.sentence: Go ahead and start without me.
items.translation: 你们先开始吧，不用等我。
explanations: **Go ahead** 请便、动手吧：允许他人开始做某事。也用于：— May I open it? — Go ahead.
近义：Please do / Be my guest. 反义：Hold on（等一下）。

sentenceAudio.text: Go ahead and start without me.

items.sentence: Have fun at the party tonight!
items.translation: 今晚派对玩得开心！
explanations: **Have fun** 告别祝福：玩得开心！最常用告别语之一，朋友出门/度假都说。
近义：Enjoy yourself / Have a good time. 例：Have fun on your trip!

sentenceAudio.text: Have fun at the party tonight!

items.sentence: Heads up — the meeting moved to 3.
items.translation: 提醒一下——会议改到 3 点了。
explanations: **Heads up** 简短提醒：注意！告诉你/有情况。heads up = 抬头关注=用注意力提醒。
近义：FYI / Just so you know. 例：Heads up — road is closed ahead.

sentenceAudio.text: Heads up — the meeting moved to 3.

items.sentence: So be it — I won't argue anymore.
items.translation: 那就随它去吧——我不再争了。
explanations: **So be it** 无奈/正式接受：那就那样吧、随它去。比 OK 更沉重，常用于失败、降级、让步场景。
近义：Let it be / That's that. 例：If you want to quit school, so be it.

sentenceAudio.text: So be it — I won't argue anymore.

items.sentence: I'll stand by you no matter what.
items.translation: 无论如何我都会支持你。
explanations: **stand by (sb)** 支持某人、站在某人一边；stand by (sth) 坚守承诺。
例：Whatever you decide, I'll stand by you. 名词形式：stand-by 候补/待命。

sentenceAudio.text: I'll stand by you no matter what.

items.sentence: That was an amazing save — you rock!
items.translation: 那个救球太精彩了——你太棒了！
explanations: **You rock** 俚语赞誉：你很棒、你太厉害了！rock = 像摇滚明星一样牛。
近义：You're awesome / You rule. 例：Thanks for the help! — You rock!

sentenceAudio.text: That was an amazing save — you rock!

items.sentence: After you — please, go in first.
items.translation: 您先请——请先进。
explanations: **After you** 礼貌让先：您先请。进门、上车、点餐都常用。
回礼：After you / No, after you. 这是基本礼仪训练场景。反义：age before beauty（幽默版）。

sentenceAudio.text: After you — please, go in first.

items.sentence: The taxi is leaving — chop chop!
items.translation: 出租车要开走了——快点快点！
explanations: **Chop chop** 拟声催促：快点快点（厨师切菜声）。中英混用范畴：儿童/老人/口音友好。
近义：Hurry up / Quickly now. 例：— Dad, we're late! — Chop chop, get in the car!

sentenceAudio.text: The taxi is leaving — chop chop!

items.sentence: Fire away — I'm listening carefully.
items.translation: 尽管问吧——我在认真听着。
explanations: **Fire away** 邀请对方开口说/问：尽管问、尽管说。原为火炮用语（开炮），引申为「开始发问」。
例：— Can I ask you something? — Sure, fire away. 答复疑问很常用的套话。

sentenceAudio.text: Fire away — I'm listening carefully.

items.sentence: Forget it — I don't care anymore.
items.translation: 算了——我不在乎了。
explanations: **Forget it** 多义：①算了别提了 ②不客气（回应 thank you 时）③不可能（强烈否认）。
语境区分：Forget it, I'll do it myself.（算了）vs. — Thanks! — Forget it.（不客气）。

sentenceAudio.text: Forget it — I don't care anymore.

items.sentence: Don't talk back to your elders.
items.translation: 别跟长辈顶嘴。
explanations: **talk back** 回嘴、顶嘴（对长辈/上级）。back = 顶回去。
例：Don't talk back to me! 近义：talk cheekily / mouth off. 注意 talk to the hand 系厌女俚语，不推荐。

sentenceAudio.text: Don't talk back to your elders.

items.sentence: That's it — I'm done with this job.
items.translation: 就这样了——我对这工作受够了。
explanations: **That's it** 终结/接受语：就这样、够了。两种语气：①够了②那就是关键/原因。
近义：I'm done / I quit / Enough. 例：That's it — I'm moving out.（就这样，我要搬走。）

sentenceAudio.text: That's it — I'm done with this job.

items.sentence: I haven't seen you for ages — what's up?
items.translation: 好久没见到你了——最近怎么样？
chunks: I haven't seen you for ages —
explanations: **What's up** 招呼/问候：怎么了？最近怎么样？非正式问候，回答常 Not much / Hey。
也可表达「出了什么事」：What's up with him? He looks angry.
distractors: I haven't talked to you for ages —
I haven't seen you for a while —
I won't see you for ages —

sentenceAudio.text: I haven't seen you for ages — what's up?

items.sentence: Ask around — somebody must know.
items.translation: 四处问问吧——总有人知道。
explanations: **ask around** 四处打听：问一圈不同的人。比 ask 更主动、覆盖更广。
例：I don't know, but I'll ask around. 反义：keep it to yourself.

sentenceAudio.text: Ask around — somebody must know.

items.sentence: I didn't catch that — come again?
items.translation: 我没听清——你再说一遍？
explanations: **Come again?** 礼貌求复：请再说一遍？比 What? 更柔和，店员/电话常用。
正式版：Could you repeat that, please? 例：— Room 305. — Come again? — Room 305.

sentenceAudio.text: I didn't catch that — come again?

items.sentence: I'm trying to study — cut it out!
items.translation: 我正想学习呢——别闹了！
explanations: **Cut it out** 命令对方停止：住手、别闹。原意「切掉它」（从中间剪开）。
近义：Knock it off / Stop it. 例：— Leave me alone! — Cut it out!

sentenceAudio.text: I'm trying to study — cut it out!

items.sentence: Be my guest — help yourself to coffee.
items.translation: 请便——随意喝咖啡吧。
explanations: **Be my guest** 客气允许：请便、随意。回应— May I sit here? — Be my guest.
与 help yourself 搭配 = 完全自便；help yourself to X 自由取用（食物/饮料）。

sentenceAudio.text: Be my guest — help yourself to coffee.

items.sentence: By no means should you open that door.
items.translation: 你绝对不应该打开那扇门。

grammar.pos: 否定状语引起部分倒装

explanations: **by no means** 绝不（加强否定）。句中位=部分倒装：By no means should you ... = You should never ...
近义：Not at all / Never / Absolutely not. 例：By no means am I going to apologize.

sentenceAudio.text: By no means should you open that door.

items.sentence: He runs the office by the book.
items.translation: 他照章办事，管那间办公室。
explanations: **by the book** 按规矩办事：照章办事。book = 法规手册/工作手册。
近义：by the rules / strictly. 反义：off the cuff（即兴）。例：The auditor runs everything by the book.
distractors: by the seat of his pants.

sentenceAudio.text: He runs the office by the book.

items.sentence: Go easy on the salt — I'm on a diet.
items.translation: 盐少放点——我在减肥。
explanations: **Go easy on** 对...温和/手下留情/少放。可接人：Go easy on him (he's new). 也可接物：Go easy on the criticism.
近义：take it easy on / be gentle with. 例：Go easy on the spicy sauce — I can't handle heat.
distractors: the sugar — I'm on a diet.
the salt — I have high blood pressure.
the salt — I'm trying to stay healthy.

sentenceAudio.text: Go easy on the salt — I'm on a diet.

items.sentence: I can't get used to waking up early.
items.translation: 我还没习惯早起。
explanations: **get used to** 习惯于（过程：从不习惯 → 习惯）。完成式可用：I'm getting used to it.
对比：be used to = 已习惯。例：I'm used to eating spicy food now. 反义：can't stand.

sentenceAudio.text: I can't get used to waking up early.

items.sentence: Keep it up — you're doing great.
items.translation: 保持下去——你做得很好。
explanations: **Keep it up** 鼓励坚持：保持下去。it = 当前表现/进度。
用于学习、锻炼、减肥，鼓励场景。也用于讽刺：Keep it up and you'll fail.（讽刺用法）

sentenceAudio.text: Keep it up — you're doing great.

items.sentence: No big deal — I'll fix it later.
items.translation: 没什么大不了——我待会儿修一下。
explanations: **No big deal** 轻描淡写：没什么大不了、别在意。回应道歉或感谢时常用：— Sorry for the mess. — No big deal.
近义：No worries / It's nothing / Don't mention it. 例：It's no big deal — I can do it tomorrow.

sentenceAudio.text: No big deal — I'll fix it later.

items.sentence: Be there at three on the dot.
items.translation: 三点整到那儿。
explanations: **on the dot** 准时：正点。dot = 时钟的整点标志。
近义：sharp / on time / precisely. 反义：fashionably late. 例：The train left at 9:00 on the dot.

sentenceAudio.text: Be there at three on the dot.

items.sentence: Can I take a rain check on dinner?
items.translation: 晚餐改天行吗？
chunks: Can I take a rain check
explanations: **rain check** 字面「雨票」（棒球术语：雨天延赛换票），引申为「改天再约」。
常在婉拒时：Can I take a rain check on that? Yes, of course, no problem. 也用于购物：May I get a rain check on the sale?

sentenceAudio.text: Can I take a rain check on dinner?

items.sentence: Settle down, kids — it's bedtime.
items.translation: 孩子们，安静下来——该睡觉了。
explanations: **Settle down** ①平静下来 ②安顿下来（搬新家：settle down in a new city）。
近义：calm down / cool down. 例：Settle down and focus! 反义：get excited.

sentenceAudio.text: Settle down, kids — it's bedtime.

items.sentence: Dinner's on me tonight — don't worry.
items.translation: 今晚晚餐我请——别担心。
explanations: **It's on me** 我请客、我来付（吃喝）。同义：My treat / I'm buying / This round is mine.
近义派生：It's on the house（店家请客）。例：Drinks are on me tonight, guys!

sentenceAudio.text: Dinner's on me tonight — don't worry.

items.sentence: I was torn between the two offers.
items.translation: 我在两个工作机会之间举棋不定。
explanations: **torn** (被动形容) 撕裂、纠结：纠结于多个选择。torn = 撕碎=难以两全。
近义：torn between A and B / can't decide / on the fence. 例：I was torn between staying home and traveling.

sentenceAudio.text: I was torn between the two offers.

items.sentence: I'm low key worried about the exam.
items.translation: 我有点小担心这个考试。
explanations: **low key** 俚语副词（来自密码 low-key = 隐藏级别），意「稍微、暗暗地」。
例：I'm low key mad about it.（我有点生气）。作形容词：a low-key party（低调派对）。

sentenceAudio.text: I'm low key worried about the exam.

items.sentence: I sort of forgot what you said.
items.translation: 我有点忘记你说的了。
explanations: **sort of** 模糊程度副词：有点、算是。弱化语调：I sort of like it.（我勉强喜欢）。
近义：kind of / somewhat. 例：I sort of agree. 口语常省 /k/: I sorta forgot.

sentenceAudio.text: I sort of forgot what you said.

items.sentence: Too bad you couldn't make it.
items.translation: 真可惜你来不了。
explanations: **Too bad** 遗憾/同情：真可惜。比 pity / lament 轻；比 What a pity 短。
近义：What a pity / That's a shame. 例：— I missed the show. — Too bad, it was great.

sentenceAudio.text: Too bad you couldn't make it.

items.sentence: I said no, so there!
items.translation: 我说不就不，就这么定了！
explanations: **So there** 强调坚持已说：就这么定了！多用于儿童/撒娇式坚持，成人可用作轻度挑衅/防御。
例：I'm not going, so there. 近义：That's that / And that's final.

sentenceAudio.text: I said no, so there!

items.sentence: She thinks she's hot stuff.
items.translation: 她觉得自己很了不起。
explanations: **hot stuff** 俚语名词：了不起的人物/热门货。原指炙手可热的事物，转喻自大的人。
例：Look at him acting like hot stuff. 近义：big shot / hot shot. 通常带点不屑/讽刺。

sentenceAudio.text: She thinks she's hot stuff.

items.sentence: I'm good — I don't need help.
items.translation: 我没事——不需要帮忙。
explanations: **I'm good** 多义：①我很好②不需要（拒人邀请/服务）。在餐厅、酒吧回应「再来一杯？」:
用 I'm good 替代 No thanks，避免尴尬。例：— Want another beer? — I'm good, thanks.

sentenceAudio.text: I'm good — I don't need help.

items.sentence: Let it go — it's not worth fighting.
items.translation: 放下吧——不值得再吵。
explanations: **Let it go** ①放手、放掉执着 ②不注意（没看到/没听到）。let it go 也是 Frozen 主题曲名。
近义：forget it / move on / get over it. 例：Let it go — we can't change the past.

sentenceAudio.text: Let it go — it's not worth fighting.

items.sentence: Own up — you broke the vase.
items.translation: 坦白承认吧——你打碎了花瓶。
explanations: **own up** 坦白承认错误：认账。常接 to：own up to it. 强调责任归属。
近义：confess / admit / come clean. 例：Own up to your mistake. 反义：deny / lie.

sentenceAudio.text: Own up — you broke the vase.

items.sentence: My dad is an easy-going man.
items.translation: 我爸是个随和的人。
explanations: **easy-going** 形容人随和、好相处。注意连字符：复合形容词。
近义：laid-back / relaxed / mellow. 反义：uptight / high-strung. 例：Her boss is really easy-going.

sentenceAudio.text: My dad is an easy-going man.

items.sentence: Forgive me — I didn't mean to interrupt.
items.translation: 对不起——我不是有意打断的。

grammar.pos: mean to do 否定过去

explanations: **Forgive me** 比 I'm sorry 更正式：恕我无礼/请宽恕。常用于道歉、插话、问古怪问题前。
注意时态：forgive 现在形表客气，一般过去 forgave 表真实原谅。例：Forgive my ignorance, but ...
distractors: I didn't mean to be rude.
I didn't mean to be late.

sentenceAudio.text: Forgive me — I didn't mean to interrupt.

items.sentence: As I say, please pay attention.
items.translation: 正如我说的，请注意听。
explanations: **As I say** 援引自己先前的话：照我说。引介方式状语。
对比：As I said = 过去（已说过）。例：As I say, focus on the basics. 也用于复议：As I say before, ...

sentenceAudio.text: As I say, please pay attention.

items.sentence: No comment on the lawsuit.
items.translation: 对这场诉讼无可奉告。
explanations: **No comment** 媒体/官方常用答：无可奉告。拒绝表态时的礼貌挡箭牌。
例：— Are you planning to resign? — No comment. 近义：I'll say no more / That's all I'll say.

sentenceAudio.text: No comment on the lawsuit.

items.sentence: Please see to it that the door is locked.
items.translation: 请确保门已上锁。
explanations: **see to it that** 确保、留意办理。书面语；see to = 处理、照料。
近义：make sure / ensure. 例：See to it that the patient gets his pills. 反义：neglect.

sentenceAudio.text: Please see to it that the door is locked.

items.sentence: That's well put — I agree.
items.translation: 说得精辟——我同意。
explanations: **well put** 称赞表达：说得好、措辞精准。put = 表达、措辞。
例：— He's not honest, just opportunistic. — Well put. 近义：well said / well put indeed.

sentenceAudio.text: That's well put — I agree.

items.sentence: I never want to see you again — drop dead!
items.translation: 我再也不想见到你——去死吧！
chunks: I never want to see you again —
explanations: **Drop dead** 极端咒骂：去死吧！极端不满/厌恶。注意：儿童/陌生人禁用，太粗鲁。
近义（较轻）：Get lost. 例：— Can you lend me $1000? — Drop dead!
distractors: I always want to see you again —
I never expect to see you again —

sentenceAudio.text: I never want to see you again — drop dead!

items.sentence: I broke your cup by accident — my bad.
items.translation: 我不小心打碎你的杯子，是我的错。
chunks: I broke your cup by accident —
hints: 我不小心打碎你的杯子

grammar.meaning: 我不小心打碎了你的杯子
是我的错（口语，比 I'm sorry 更随意）

explanations: **my bad** 是非常口语的认错方式，等于 It's my fault，但更轻快。同龄人/熟人间用，正式场合别用。
近义：my fault / I'm sorry / that's on me（责任在我）。例句：Sorry, my bad — I sent it to the wrong person.
distractors: I dropped your cup by accident —
I broke your phone by accident —
I broke your cup on purpose —

sentenceAudio.text: I broke your cup by accident — my bad.

items.sentence: Stop picking on him — he's half your size.
items.translation: 别欺负他了，他个头才你一半。
explanations: **pick on** 指「专挑某个人欺负/找茬」，有针对性，比 bully 轻但仍是负向。反义：stand up for（护着某人）。
辨析：pick at 是「挑剔/小口吃」，pick on 是「欺负」。例句：The boss always picks on the new guy.

sentenceAudio.text: Stop picking on him — he's half your size.

items.sentence: We sat by the lake and soaked up the sunshine.
items.translation: 我们坐在湖边尽情享受阳光。
explanations: **soak up** 本义「吸收（液体）」，引申为尽情享受（阳光/氛围/知识）：soak up the atmosphere / soak up knowledge。
近义：take in / bask in。例句：I love soaking up the café vibe on weekend mornings.
distractors: and soaked up the fresh air.

sentenceAudio.text: We sat by the lake and soaked up the sunshine.

items.sentence: Don't pass up this chance to study abroad.
items.translation: 别错过这个出国留学的机会。
explanations: **pass up** 是「放弃（难得的机会/好事）」，通常带惋惜感。常用于劝人：Don't pass up…/ You'd be crazy to pass that up。
近义：turn down（拒绝）/ miss out on（错过）。反义：seize the opportunity。例句：She passed up a great job offer to stay with her family.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't pass up this chance to study abroad.

items.sentence: "Can you help me move this box?" — "You bet!"
items.translation: 能帮我搬这个箱子吗？当然可以！
chunks: "Can you help me move this box?" —

grammar.meaning: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗

explanations: **You bet!** 表示「当然！没问题！」，比 sure 更有热情。来自打赌引申的「你尽管放心」，熟人客套都合适。
近义：Absolutely! / Of course! / You betcha（更随意的变体）。例句：— Thanks for the ride! — You bet!
distractors: "Can you help me move this car?" —
"Can you watch me move this box?" —
"Can you help me open this box?" —

sentenceAudio.text: "Can you help me move this box?" — "You bet!"

items.sentence: It's been a year — time to move on.
items.translation: 都一年了，该往前看了。
explanations: **move on** 指「放下过去、继续前行」，用于分手/离职/失败后的劝慰。也可字面义「继续走/继续做下一件事」。
常见搭配：move on to something（接着做某事）。例句：Stop dwelling on the past and move on with your life.

sentenceAudio.text: It's been a year — time to move on.

items.sentence: Before you quit, step back and think it over.
items.translation: 辞职之前退一步，好好想想。
chunks: step back and think it over.
explanations: **step back** 从字面「往后退一步」引申为「抽离当下、换个视角冷静看」，常用于情绪上头时的建议。
近义：take a step back / look at the big picture。例句：Sometimes you need to step back to see the whole problem.
distractors: step forward and think it over.
sit back and think it over.

sentenceAudio.text: Before you quit, step back and think it over.

items.sentence: You fixed it in five minutes — nice going!
items.translation: 你五分钟就修好了，干得漂亮！
chunks: You fixed it in five minutes —
explanations: **nice going** 是口语称赞「干得好/漂亮」，口语感强。也可反讽（对方搞砸时阴阳怪气地说 nice going）。
近义：well done / good job / way to go。例句：Nice going! You solved the puzzle in no time.
distractors: You fixed it in five hours —
You found it in five minutes —

sentenceAudio.text: You fixed it in five minutes — nice going!

items.sentence: Patience isn't my strong suit, I admit.
items.translation: 我承认耐心不是我的强项。
explanations: **strong suit** 源自牌戏「一手强牌」，引申为「某人最擅长的领域/技能」。句型：…isn't my strong suit = 我不擅长…。
反义：weak point / Achilles' heel（致命弱点）。例句：Small talk is not my strong suit, but I try.

sentenceAudio.text: Patience isn't my strong suit, I admit.

items.sentence: Don't worry — these things happen, it happens to everyone.
items.translation: 别担心，这种事难免，谁都会碰上。
explanations: **it happens** 是宽慰他人的万能句，意思是「这种事难免/正常」，劝人别自责别尴尬。
用法场景：对方迟到/犯错/出糗时说一句 It happens，气氛立刻松下来。例句：I spilled coffee on my shirt again — it happens.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't worry — these things happen, it happens to everyone.

items.sentence: I've been feeling down since I lost my job.
items.translation: 丢了工作以后我一直情绪低落。
explanations: **feel down** 表示情绪低落、提不起劲，比 sad 更日常口语。程度深可说 feel really down / down in the dumps。
近义：feel blue / be in low spirits。例句：She's been down all week — let's cheer her up.

sentenceAudio.text: I've been feeling down since I lost my job.

items.sentence: I'd rather go alone, but suit yourself.
items.translation: 我宁可自己去，不过你随意。
explanations: **suit yourself** 有两面语气：中性「随你意，我不勉强」，也常带轻微不满（对方不听劝时的「随你吧」）。
例句：— I'll wear this shirt even if it's ugly. — Fine, suit yourself.

sentenceAudio.text: I'd rather go alone, but suit yourself.

items.sentence: That's enough TV for tonight — go to bed.
items.translation: 今晚电视看到这就够了，去睡觉。
hints: 今晚电视看到这就够了，

grammar.meaning: 今晚电视看到这就够了

explanations: **that's enough** 是制止语「够了/到此为止」，父母制止孩子、或人忍无可忍时都用，语气随重音可柔可硬。
近义：enough is enough（受够了）/ cut it out（别闹了）。例句：That's enough complaining for one day!
distractors: That's too much TV for tonight —

sentenceAudio.text: That's enough TV for tonight — go to bed.

items.sentence: I almost agreed, but on second thought I declined.
items.translation: 我差点就答应了，但转念一想又回绝了。
explanations: **on second thought** 表示「再一想、改变主意」，常单独成句或放句首，口语标志性表达。美式拼作 on second thought，英式 second thoughts。
例句：I'll have coffee — actually, on second thought, make it tea.

sentenceAudio.text: I almost agreed, but on second thought I declined.

items.sentence: She's been seeing someone from work for months.
items.translation: 她跟一个同事交往好几个月了。
chunks: She's been seeing someone from work
hints: 她一直在和一位同事交往

grammar.role: 现在完成进行时+交往表达
grammar.meaning: 她一直在和一位同事交往

explanations: **seeing someone** 是「与某人交往中」的委婉说法，比 dating 更口语低调。问别人感情状态常说：Are you seeing anyone?
近义：dating / going out with。例句：I heard she's seeing a guy from the marketing team.
distractors: She was seeing someone from school
She kept meeting someone from work

sentenceAudio.text: She's been seeing someone from work for months.

items.sentence: Stop fooling around and finish your homework.
items.translation: 别瞎闹了，把作业写完。
explanations: **fool around** 指「瞎闹、不干正事」，家长老师高频用。也委婉指「（背地里）乱搞男女关系」，后者看语境。
近义：mess around / goof off。例句：We fooled around all afternoon instead of studying.

sentenceAudio.text: Stop fooling around and finish your homework.

items.sentence: That magic trick was really something — how did you do it?
items.translation: 这个魔术真有两下子，你是怎么做到的？
chunks: That magic trick was really something —
explanations: **really something** 表示「真了不起、有两下子」，口语赞叹。反义结构：not much of a…（算不上…）。
例句：That new restaurant is really something — the dessert alone is worth it.
distractors: That magic show was really something —
That card trick was really something —

sentenceAudio.text: That magic trick was really something — how did you do it?

items.sentence: At forty she's no spring chicken, but she runs every day.
items.translation: 她四十了不算年轻，但每天都跑步。
chunks: At forty she's no spring chicken,
explanations: **no spring chicken** 幽默地说「不年轻了」，多用于自嘲或善意调侃，注意别对长辈冒犯使用。
例句：He may be no spring chicken, but he can still hike ten miles.
distractors: At fifty she's no spring chicken,
At forty she's a spring chicken,

sentenceAudio.text: At forty she's no spring chicken, but she runs every day.

items.sentence: Sleep on it and tell me your decision tomorrow.
items.translation: 你先考虑一晚上，明天告诉我决定。
chunks: and tell me your decision tomorrow.
explanations: **sleep on it** 劝人别急着拍板，先过一夜冷静想。销售/谈判/大额消费场景高频。
例句：It's a big loan — why don't you sleep on it and call me tomorrow?
distractors: and tell me your plans tomorrow.
and text me your decision tomorrow.

sentenceAudio.text: Sleep on it and tell me your decision tomorrow.

items.sentence: The surprise party you threw really made my day.
items.translation: 你给我办的惊喜派对让我开心了一整天。
explanations: **make my day** 直译「成就了我的一天」，即「让我特别开心/值了」。对方做了暖心小事后的最佳回应。
经典梗：克林特·伊斯特伍德电影台词 Go ahead, make my day。例句：A coffee from you always makes my day.

sentenceAudio.text: The surprise party you threw really made my day.

items.sentence: His joke about her weight was way out of line.
items.translation: 他拿她体重开玩笑，太过分了。
explanations: **out of line** 指言行「越界、出格、不合规矩」，批评别人的冒犯言行时用。way 是强调词，意为「太出格了」。
近义：cross the line / out of order。例句：That comment was out of line — you owe her an apology.

sentenceAudio.text: His joke about her weight was way out of line.

items.sentence: We'd better hit the road before the traffic gets bad.
items.translation: 趁还没堵车，我们最好出发了。
explanations: **hit the road** 口语「出发、上路」，road trip 出发前必说。近义 hit the sack 则是「上床睡觉」。
例句：Let's hit the road at six to beat the morning rush.

sentenceAudio.text: We'd better hit the road before the traffic gets bad.

items.sentence: Knock it off, you two — I'm trying to study.
items.translation: 你俩别闹了，我要学习。
explanations: **knock it off** 是呵斥「别闹了/停下来」，比 stop it 更强硬直接，老师制止打闹的孩子常用。
近义：cut it out / quit it。例句：Knock it off with the drumming — it's midnight!

sentenceAudio.text: Knock it off, you two — I'm trying to study.

items.sentence: You passed the interview — good for you!
items.translation: 你通过面试了，真为你高兴！
explanations: **good for you** 祝贺对方的好消息：「真棒/为你高兴」。注意语气真诚时说祝贺，阴阳怪气时是讽刺，全靠语调。
例句：— I finally quit smoking. — Good for you, that's not easy!

sentenceAudio.text: You passed the interview — good for you!

items.sentence: Feel free to ask questions — by all means interrupt me.
items.translation: 有问题尽管问，随时打断我都可以。
explanations: **by all means** 强化允许：「当然可以、尽管来」，比 sure 更恳切正式，也可回答请求：— May I sit here? — By all means!
反义：by no means（绝不）。例句：By all means, take your time reading the contract.
distractors: Feel free to ask for help —

sentenceAudio.text: Feel free to ask questions — by all means interrupt me.

items.sentence: The concert was sold out — we got in by the skin of our teeth.
items.translation: 演唱会门票卖光了，我们好不容易才挤进去，差点没进去。
chunks: we got in by the skin of our teeth.
hints: 我们侥幸挤了进去，差一点就没进去

grammar.pos: got in by the skin of one's teeth
grammar.meaning: 我们侥幸挤了进去，差一点就没进去

explanations: **by the skin of one's teeth** 形象表达「侥幸脱险/勉强赶上」，像只剩牙皮那点距离。考试低空飞过、赶车最后一秒都适用。
例句：I caught my flight by the skin of my teeth — the gate was already closing.
distractors: The concert was almost sold out —
we got in without any trouble.
we failed to get in at all.

sentenceAudio.text: The concert was sold out — we got in by the skin of our teeth.

items.sentence: Don't worry — I've got your back no matter what.
items.translation: 别担心，不管怎样我都挺你。
explanations: **have got someone's back** 形象表达「我罩着你/挺你」，出事时站在你这边。朋友间的定心丸。
近义：stand by someone / back someone up。例句：Whatever happens in the meeting, I've got your back.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't worry — I've got your back no matter what.

items.sentence: Whenever I'm in trouble, I turn to my best friend.
items.translation: 一有麻烦，我就会向最好的朋友求助。
chunks: I turn to my best friend.
hints: 我就向最好的朋友求助

grammar.meaning: 我就向最好的朋友求助

explanations: **turn to** 字面「转向某人」，引申「求助、依靠」。turn to sb for help / advice 是固定搭配。
近义：rely on / count on。例句：When the project failed, he turned to his mentor for guidance.
distractors: I turn to my old friend.

sentenceAudio.text: Whenever I'm in trouble, I turn to my best friend.

items.sentence: That joke is killing me — I can't stop laughing.
items.translation: 这笑话要笑死我了，根本停不下来。
explanations: **something is killing me** 夸张表达「某事让我受不了/笑死我了」，口语高频。也可表疼痛：My back is killing me（腰快疼死了）。
例句：This show is killing me — every episode is hilarious.
distractors: That joke is driving me crazy —

sentenceAudio.text: That joke is killing me — I can't stop laughing.

items.sentence: Cut the jokes — let's get serious for a minute.
items.translation: 别开玩笑了，我们认真一会儿。
explanations: **get serious** 是「说正经的/认真起来」，通常标志话题从玩笑转向严肃。cut the jokes 是其铺垫。
例句：Okay, enough fun — let's get serious about the deadline.

sentenceAudio.text: Cut the jokes — let's get serious for a minute.

items.sentence: The builder cut corners and now the wall is cracking.
items.translation: 施工队偷工减料，现在墙都开裂了。
chunks: and now the wall is cracking.
explanations: **cut corners** 指「为省时省钱而偷工减料、走捷径」，通常带贬义，工程质量/产品质量场景常用。
近义：take shortcuts。例句：Never cut corners on safety equipment — it saves lives.
distractors: and now the wall is falling.
and now the wall is shaking.

sentenceAudio.text: The builder cut corners and now the wall is cracking.

items.sentence: She paid good money for that designer handbag.
items.translation: 她花了大价钱买那个名牌包。
explanations: **pay good money for** 意为「花大价钱/真金白银买」，强调东西不便宜、理应质量好。抱怨质量时常用：I paid good money for this!
例句：We paid good money for those tickets — the seats better be great.

sentenceAudio.text: She paid good money for that designer handbag.

items.sentence: Stop second-guessing yourself and just send the email.
items.translation: 别反复纠结了，把邮件发出去就行。

grammar.meaning: 别再自我怀疑/反复纠结

explanations: **second-guess** 指「事后反复怀疑自己当初的决定」，动词可直接加宾语。比 hesitate 多了「回头看」的意味。
例句：Stop second-guessing the interview answers — what's done is done.

sentenceAudio.text: Stop second-guessing yourself and just send the email.

items.sentence: Hey, what's new with you these days?
items.translation: 嘿，你最近有什么新鲜事吗？
explanations: **What's new?** 是比 How are you 更亲密的寒暄，问对方近况和新鲜事。熟人间高频开场白。
回答套路：Not much（没啥特别的）/ Same as usual。例句：— What's new? — Just started a new job!

sentenceAudio.text: Hey, what's new with you these days?

items.sentence: Fill me in — I need to get up to speed on this project.
items.translation: 给我讲讲，我得尽快跟上这个项目的进度。
chunks: I need to get up to speed
explanations: **up to speed** 指「跟上最新进度、掌握全部信息」，职场高频。get/be/bring sb up to speed 三种搭配都要会用。
例句：Can you bring me up to speed on what happened at the meeting?
distractors: I don't need to get up to speed

sentenceAudio.text: Fill me in — I need to get up to speed on this project.

items.sentence: You can't copy my homework — do it on your own.
items.translation: 你不能抄我作业，得自己做。
explanations: **on one's own** = alone / independently，「靠自己、独立地」。表「独自一人」或「独立完成」都行。
近义：by yourself / single-handedly。例句：She built the whole website on her own.
distractors: do it at your own pace.

sentenceAudio.text: You can't copy my homework — do it on your own.

items.sentence: He didn't respect me, so I told him to take a hike.
items.translation: 他不尊重我，我就叫他滚一边去。
chunks: so I told him to take a hike.
explanations: **take a hike** 是不客气的「走开/一边去」，比 go away 更强硬粗鲁，生气或赶人时用，正式场合禁用。
近义：get lost / buzz off。例句：If you're just here to complain, take a hike.
distractors: so I told him to take a seat.
so I told him to take a break.

sentenceAudio.text: He didn't respect me, so I told him to take a hike.

items.sentence: You broke my laptop, so don't ask for a favor — you asked for it.
items.translation: 你弄坏了我的笔记本，就别来求我帮忙了，你自找的。
chunks: so don't ask for a favor —
explanations: **ask for it** 表示「自找麻烦/咎由自取」，常用于对方不听劝告后出了状况时的责难：You asked for it!
例句：I warned him not to drive drunk — when he got caught, he asked for it.
distractors: so don't beg for a favor —

sentenceAudio.text: You broke my laptop, so don't ask for a favor — you asked for it.

items.sentence: "This plan won't work." — "You said it!"
items.translation: 「这方案行不通。」「说得太对了！
explanations: **You said it!** 强烈附和对方：「说得太对/可不是嘛」，比 I agree 更口语带劲，像中文「说到点上了」。
例句：— The traffic here is awful. — You said it!

sentenceAudio.text: "This plan won't work." — "You said it!"

items.sentence: The team dropped the ball and lost the biggest client.
items.translation: 团队掉了链子，丢了最大的客户。
explanations: **drop the ball** 源自球类「接球失误」，引申「搞砸、失职、关键时刻掉链子」，职场批评常用。
近义：mess up / blow it。例句：HR dropped the ball on the offer letter — the candidate took another job.

sentenceAudio.text: The team dropped the ball and lost the biggest client.

items.sentence: Hold your horses — we haven't even checked the price yet.
items.translation: 别急嘛，我们还没看价钱呢。
chunks: we haven't even checked the price yet.
explanations: **hold your horses** 字面「勒住你的马」，口语「别急/慢着」，拦着冲动的人先等等，带点调侃。
例句：Hold your horses! Let me finish explaining before you judge.
distractors: we haven't even paid the price yet.
we haven't even asked the price yet.

sentenceAudio.text: Hold your horses — we haven't even checked the price yet.

items.sentence: Watch your mouth — that's not how you talk to your mother.
items.translation: 说话注意点，这不是你对妈妈说话该有的态度。
chunks: that's not how you talk to your mother.
hints: 这不是你对妈妈说话的方式

grammar.meaning: 那不是跟妈妈说话的方式

explanations: **watch your mouth** 警告对方「说话注意点」，对方爆粗口或无礼时用，语气较硬。
近义：mind your language。例句：Watch your mouth in front of the kids.
distractors: that's not how you talk to your boss.
that's not how you talk to your friends.

sentenceAudio.text: Watch your mouth — that's not how you talk to your mother.

items.sentence: "Can you fix the printer by noon?" — "Consider it done."
items.translation: 「中午前能修好打印机吗？」「包在我身上。
chunks: "Can you fix the printer by noon?" —
hints: 你能中午前修好打印机吗

grammar.meaning: 你能中午前修好打印机吗
就当办好了，包在我身上

explanations: **Consider it done** 是干脆利落的承诺：「包在我身上/当它已经办好了」，比 I'll do it 更有把握感，商务场合也合适。
例句：— Could you book a table for two? — Consider it done.
distractors: "Can you fix the printer by Friday?" —
"Can you fix the computer by noon?" —

sentenceAudio.text: "Can you fix the printer by noon?" — "Consider it done."

items.sentence: Don't you dare touch my phone again!
items.translation: 你敢再碰我手机试试！
explanations: **Don't you dare!** 是严厉警告「你敢！/ 你敢试试！」，比 don't 强硬得多，带威胁语气，通常最后通牒式使用。
例句：Don't you dare tell anyone about this!

sentenceAudio.text: Don't you dare touch my phone again!

items.sentence: For the record, I never agreed to that price.
items.translation: 把话说清楚，我从没同意过那个价钱。

grammar.meaning: 为记录在案、把话说清楚

explanations: **for the record** 源自会议记录用语，现常表示「先声明清楚/把话说在前面」，避免日后被误解。
例句：For the record, I was against this idea from day one.

sentenceAudio.text: For the record, I never agreed to that price.

items.sentence: Apply anyway — you never know what might happen.
items.translation: 先投了再说，结果谁知道呢。
explanations: **you never know** 表示「世事难料/说不定呢」，鼓励对方尝试时常用，也可表达不把话说死。
例句：Give it a shot — you never know unless you try.

sentenceAudio.text: Apply anyway — you never know what might happen.

items.sentence: Strike a pose — this photo will be on the cover.
items.translation: 摆个姿势，这张照片要上封面。
chunks: this photo will be on the cover.
explanations: **strike a pose** 是摄影/时尚圈的「摆姿势」固定说法，strike 这里不是「打」而是「摆出」。
例句：The photographer asked her to strike a pose by the window.
distractors: this photo will be on the wall.
this photo will be in the album.

sentenceAudio.text: Strike a pose — this photo will be on the cover.

items.sentence: The boss wants the report — on the double!
items.translation: 老板要那份报告，立刻马上！
explanations: **on the double** 源自军队口令「跑步走」，口语表「立即、赶快」，比 right now 更有催促感。
近义：right away / ASAP。例句：Get the ambulance here on the double!

sentenceAudio.text: The boss wants the report — on the double!

items.sentence: Make it quick — I have a meeting in ten minutes.
items.translation: 有话快说，我十分钟后有个会。
chunks: I have a meeting in ten minutes.
explanations: **make it quick** 催促对方「快点/长话短说」，常用于没时间的场景，语气直接但不失礼。
近义：keep it short / cut to the chase。例句：Make it quick — the store closes in five minutes.
distractors: I have a meeting in ten days.
I have an appointment in ten minutes.

sentenceAudio.text: Make it quick — I have a meeting in ten minutes.

items.sentence: Don't push it — I already said no twice.
items.translation: 别得寸进尺，我已经说了两次不了。
explanations: **don't push it** 警告对方适可而止：「别得寸进尺/别蹬鼻子上脸」，对方已越界或贪心时的最后提醒。
例句：You got a raise last month — don't push it by asking for more.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't push it — I already said no twice.

items.sentence: Come in and make yourself at home.
items.translation: 进来吧，别客气当自己家。

grammar.meaning: 别拘束，像在自己家一样

explanations: **make yourself at home** 是主人招呼客人的标准客套话：「随意点、别拘束、当自己家」。
例句：The host said, "Make yourself at home — grab a drink from the fridge."

sentenceAudio.text: Come in and make yourself at home.

items.sentence: Easy does it — that box has glass inside.
items.translation: 轻拿轻放，那箱子里有玻璃。
explanations: **easy does it** 提醒对方「悠着点、慢来轻来」，搬运重物、做精细操作时常用，语气温和。
近义：take it slow / gently。例句：Easy does it with the paint — don't rush the strokes.
distractors: that box has no glass inside.

sentenceAudio.text: Easy does it — that box has glass inside.

items.sentence: Get off my back — I'll clean my room when I want to.
items.translation: 别老唠叨我，我想收拾房间自然会收拾。
chunks: I'll clean my room when I want to.
hints: 我想收拾时自然会收拾

grammar.meaning: 我想收拾房间时就收拾

explanations: **get off my back** 对被唠叨/施压的人说：「别烦我了/别老盯着我」，孩子对父母、下属对上司都常见。
近义：stop nagging me / leave me alone。例句：Get off my back — I'll submit the report tonight!
distractors: I'll clean my room when I have to.
I'll clean my room when I can.

sentenceAudio.text: Get off my back — I'll clean my room when I want to.

items.sentence: She's had a crush on her classmate since middle school.
items.translation: 她从中学起就一直暗恋那个同学。
chunks: She's had a crush on her classmate

grammar.pos: have a crush on sb 暗恋

explanations: **have a crush on someone** 指「暗恋某人」，是青涩单向的喜欢，区别于认真的恋爱关系。
例句：I had a huge crush on my English teacher in high school.
distractors: She's kept an eye on her teacher
She's taken care of her neighbor

sentenceAudio.text: She's had a crush on her classmate since middle school.

items.sentence: Give me a break — I've been working nonstop for eight hours.
items.translation: 饶了我吧，我已经连轴转了八小时。
chunks: I've been working nonstop for eight hours.
hints: 我已经连续工作八小时了

grammar.meaning: 我已经不停地工作了八小时

explanations: **give me a break** 两种语气：①求饶「饶了我吧/让我歇歇」；②不信「别逗了/少来这套」（对方说离谱话时）。
例句：— I ran a marathon last week. — Give me a break, you hate running!
distractors: I've been working nonstop for eight days.
I've been working here for eight hours.

sentenceAudio.text: Give me a break — I've been working nonstop for eight hours.

items.sentence: You paid for dinner last time, so drinks are on me.
items.translation: 上次晚饭是你付的钱，这次饮料我请。
chunks: You paid for dinner last time, so
hints: 上次晚饭是你付的钱，所以

grammar.meaning: 上次晚饭是你付的钱，所以

explanations: **it's on me** 表示「费用我来付」，可用于吃饭、饮料、票等具体花费。同义：It's my treat / I'll pick up the tab。
例句：I got the tickets, so popcorn is on me.
distractors: You cooked dinner last time, so
You ordered dinner last time, so

sentenceAudio.text: You paid for dinner last time, so drinks are on me.

items.sentence: Just a minute — I need to grab my keys.
items.translation: 稍等一下，我拿个钥匙。
chunks: I need to grab my keys.
explanations: **just a minute** 让对方稍候，比 wait 更礼貌自然。同义：just a second / hold on。
例句：Just a minute, let me check my schedule first.
distractors: I need to grab my coat.
I need to find my keys.

sentenceAudio.text: Just a minute — I need to grab my keys.

items.sentence: I have nothing to lose by telling you the truth.
items.translation: 跟你说实话，我没什么可失去的。
explanations: **have nothing to lose** 表示「豁出去了/没什么可失去的」，常给犹豫的人壮胆，也形容已经跌到谷底无后顾之忧。
例句：Ask her out — you have nothing to lose.

sentenceAudio.text: I have nothing to lose by telling you the truth.

items.sentence: You've been working all day — take it easy tonight.
items.translation: 你今天忙了一整天，今晚好好歇歇。
explanations: **take it easy** 意为「放轻松/悠着点」，既是日常安慰也是建议。比 relax 更主动。
近义：chill out / don't push yourself。例句：Take it easy — there's no rush.

sentenceAudio.text: You've been working all day — take it easy tonight.

items.sentence: "Work fewer hours?" — "Easy for you to say!"
items.translation: 「少加点班？」「你说得倒轻巧！
explanations: **easy for you to say** 对方站着说话不腰疼时的常用回应：「你倒说得轻松」，含反讽/抱怨。
例句：— Just save more money! — Easy for you to say, with your fancy job.

sentenceAudio.text: "Work fewer hours?" — "Easy for you to say!"

items.sentence: You can argue, but at the end of the day it's my call.
items.translation: 你可以争，但说到底还是我说了算。
chunks: at the end of the day
explanations: **at the end of the day** 总结用语「说到底、归根结底」，把争论拉回本质。
近义：when all is said and done / ultimately。例句：At the end of the day, the customer is always right.
distractors: in the middle of the day
at the end of the week

sentenceAudio.text: You can argue, but at the end of the day it's my call.

items.sentence: Have it your way — I'm done arguing with you.
items.translation: 随你吧，我懒得跟你吵了。
explanations: **have it your way** = suit yourself 升级版「随你吧/随你的便」，常带无奈放弃争论的语气。
例句：— Let's order pizza. — Fine, have it your way.

sentenceAudio.text: Have it your way — I'm done arguing with you.

items.sentence: What's the matter — you look upset?
items.translation: 怎么了，你看起来不开心？
explanations: **what's the matter** 表关心：「出什么事了/怎么了」，朋友发现你情绪不对时的开场。
近义：what's wrong / what's up。例句：— What's the matter, honey? — Nothing, just tired.

sentenceAudio.text: What's the matter — you look upset?

items.sentence: He's good for nothing — never finishes a single task.
items.translation: 他一点用没有，从来没完成过一件事。

grammar.meaning: 他从未完成过任何一件任务

explanations: **good for nothing** 形容人「一无是处/没用的」，语气较重，慎用避免伤人。
近义：useless / worthless。例句：This old phone is good for nothing — time to recycle it.

sentenceAudio.text: He's good for nothing — never finishes a single task.

items.sentence: Show some respect — that's your father you're talking to.
items.translation: 放尊重点，你在跟你爸说话呢。
chunks: that's your father you're talking to.
hints: 你现在说话的可是你父亲

grammar.meaning: 你现在说话的可是你父亲

explanations: **show some respect** 是长辈/上级对不敬者的警告：「放尊重点」，语气直接。
例句：Show some respect when the flag is passing by.
distractors: that's your father you're yelling at.
that's your boss you're talking to.

sentenceAudio.text: Show some respect — that's your father you're talking to.

items.sentence: Don't get involved — it's not your business.
items.translation: 别掺和了，这不关你的事。
explanations: **get involved** 指「参与、卷进」。don't get involved 是劝人别趟浑水的常用建议。
近义：stay out of it / mind your own business。例句：Don't get involved in office gossip — it never ends well.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't get involved — it's not your business.

items.sentence: "Thanks for helping!" — "Don't mention it."
items.translation: 「谢谢你帮忙！」「别提了（不客气）。
explanations: **don't mention it** 是回应致谢的客套话，等于 You're welcome，比 no problem 更正式。
近义：not at all / my pleasure。例句：— I appreciate the help. — Don't mention it, that's what friends are for.

sentenceAudio.text: "Thanks for helping!" — "Don't mention it."

items.sentence: How have you been since you moved to Berlin?
items.translation: 搬到柏林以来你过得怎么样？
explanations: **How have you been** 是久未见面时的寒暄开场，比 how are you 更关切对方近期情况。
回答：Pretty good / Same as usual / Been better. 例句：— How have you been? — Same old, same old.

sentenceAudio.text: How have you been since you moved to Berlin?

items.sentence: Keep in touch — I want to know how you're doing.
items.translation: 保持联系，我想知道你的近况。
chunks: I want to know how you're doing.

grammar.meaning: 我想知道你过得怎么样

explanations: **keep in touch** 告别或社交媒体互动时的标准客套：「保持联系」，结束对话或更新动态时高频。
近义：stay in touch / keep me posted（保持更新）。例句：Keep in touch — and send me photos from the trip!
distractors: I want to know where you're going.
I want to see how you're doing.

sentenceAudio.text: Keep in touch — I want to know how you're doing.

items.sentence: You're ready — go for it!
items.translation: 你准备好了，去争取吧！
explanations: **go for it** 是「放手一搏/去争取」的口语鼓励，常见于比赛/面试/追求等场景。
近义：go ahead / give it a shot。例句：Apply for the scholarship — just go for it.

sentenceAudio.text: You're ready — go for it!

items.sentence: Can you give me a ride to the airport tomorrow?
items.translation: 明天能顺路载我去机场吗？
explanations: **give me a ride** 是请求搭车的标准说法，比 drive me 更礼貌、更口语。
近义：give me a lift / take me to…。例句：If you're heading downtown, can you give me a lift?

sentenceAudio.text: Can you give me a ride to the airport tomorrow?

items.sentence: Give me a minute — I'll be right back.
items.translation: 等我一下，我马上回来。
explanations: **give me a minute** 是请求别人「等一会儿」，立刻回来时用。比 just a minute 多了「我保证只等一分钟」的意味。
近义：hold on / hang on。例句：Give me a minute, the file is downloading.

sentenceAudio.text: Give me a minute — I'll be right back.

items.sentence: I'm looking forward to seeing you this weekend.
items.translation: 我盼着这个周末见到你。
explanations: **look forward to** 是「期待/盼着」，to 是介词（不是不定式），后接名词或动名词。最常用于信末/邮件结尾。
例句：I look forward to hearing from you soon.（盼望尽快回复）

sentenceAudio.text: I'm looking forward to seeing you this weekend.

items.sentence: Have a good time at the concert — say hi to the band!
items.translation: 演唱会玩得开心，替我跟乐队问好！
explanations: **have a good time** 是告别时的标准祝福「玩得开心」。**say hi to sb** 是「替我向某人问好」。
例句：Have a good time at the party! Say hi to everyone for me.

sentenceAudio.text: Have a good time at the concert — say hi to the band!

items.sentence: Get well soon — the whole team misses you.
items.translation: 快点好起来，整个团队都惦记你。
explanations: **get well soon** 是同事/朋友生病时的标准祝福，可送花/卡片/邮件都用。
例句：Get well soon — let me know if you need anything.

sentenceAudio.text: Get well soon — the whole team misses you.

items.sentence: Don't take it for granted — not everyone gets a second chance.
items.translation: 别把这当成理所当然，不是谁都再有第二次机会的。
chunks: not everyone gets a second chance.
hints: 不是谁都再有第二次机会

grammar.meaning: 不是每个人都能获得第二次机会

explanations: **take ... for granted** 是「把…当成理所当然/不珍惜」，父母对孩子、伴侣对关心时常用。
例句：She took her assistant's hard work for granted — until she quit.
distractors: not everyone gets a second job.
not everyone gets a first chance.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't take it for granted — not everyone gets a second chance.

items.sentence: Could I have a word with you in private?
items.translation: 能私下跟你说几句话吗？
chunks: have a word with you in private?

grammar.pos: have a word with sb privately

explanations: **have a word with** 是「私下谈几句」，比 talk to 更含蓄有礼，常用于请人离开公众场合。
近义：speak privately / have a quick chat。例句：Do you have a minute? I'd like to have a word with you.
distractors: have a talk with you in public?
have a word with me in a minute?

sentenceAudio.text: Could I have a word with you in private?

items.sentence: I'll cover the tip — it's a deal!
items.translation: 小费我出，就这么定了！
explanations: **it's a deal** 是「成交/就这么定了」的口语承诺，商务/朋友间握手成交都可用。
近义：deal! / done! / you got it!。例句：— I'll do the dishes tonight. — It's a deal.

sentenceAudio.text: I'll cover the tip — it's a deal!

items.sentence: You ate the last slice, and now you owe me.
items.translation: 你吃掉了最后一片，你欠我一份。
explanations: **you owe me** 字面「你欠我」，引申「你欠我一个交代/一个回应」，可用于朋友间要说法、调侃。
例句：You ruined my favorite mug — you owe me!

sentenceAudio.text: You ate the last slice, and now you owe me.

items.sentence: We have pasta, salad, soup — you name it, we've got it.
items.translation: 我们有意大利面、沙拉、汤——你要什么有什么。
explanations: **you name it** 是「随便你说/你能想到的都有」，表货源丰富、应有尽有。
近义：and then some / you name it, we have it。例句：We sell anything — you name it.

sentenceAudio.text: We have pasta, salad, soup — you name it, we've got it.

items.sentence: Don't bother — I'll do it myself.
items.translation: 别操心了，我自己来。
explanations: **don't bother** 拒绝别人帮忙：「不用麻烦你了」，礼貌地接手或拒绝。
近义：no worries / don't trouble yourself。例句：— Can I help with the dishes? — Don't bother, I've got it.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't bother — I'll do it myself.

items.sentence: Look out — there's a car coming!
items.translation: 当心，有车来了！
explanations: **look out!** 是危险预警「当心」，紧急程度高于 watch out，比 be careful 紧迫。
近义：watch out / heads up。例句：Look out! The stove is hot!

sentenceAudio.text: Look out — there's a car coming!

items.sentence: Watch out — the floor is slippery.
items.translation: 小心，地滑。
explanations: **watch out** 是日常提醒「小心」，比 look out 语气弱，更接近注意/留神。
近义：be careful / mind your step。例句：Watch out for the step down — it's hard to see.

sentenceAudio.text: Watch out — the floor is slippery.

items.sentence: I need to know your decision — just say the word.
items.translation: 我需要知道你的决定，你开口就行。
chunks: I need to know your decision —
explanations: **say the word** = just let me know「随时说一声就行」，表示只要你开口我就行动。
例句：If you need help moving, just say the word.
distractors: I need to know your name —
I need to know your address —

sentenceAudio.text: I need to know your decision — just say the word.

items.sentence: Don't worry about the kids — leave it to me.
items.translation: 孩子们交给我来照顾，你不用操心。
explanations: **leave it to me** 是承接任务的承诺：「交给我/包在我身上」，比 I'll do it 更有担当。
近义：consider it done / I'll handle it。例句：— Who will close the deal? — Leave it to me.

sentenceAudio.text: Don't worry about the kids — leave it to me.

items.sentence: Mind your own business — I'm fine on my own.
items.translation: 管好你自己的事，我自己一个人能行。
explanations: **mind your own business** 是被多管闲事时的标准回击：「管好你自己」，态度明确。
近义：stay out of it / it's none of your business。例句：Mind your own business, or I'll mind it for you.
distractors: I'm not fine on my own.

sentenceAudio.text: Mind your own business — I'm fine on my own.

items.sentence: Come on, we're going to be late for the movie.
items.translation: 快点儿，电影要迟到了。
chunks: we're going to be late for the movie.
explanations: **come on** 多功能：催促「快点/得啦」+ 鼓励「加油」+ 不信「得了吧」。
例句：Come on, you can do it! I believe in you.
distractors: we're going to be late for school.
we're going to be early for the movie.

sentenceAudio.text: Come on, we're going to be late for the movie.

items.sentence: Let me see — I think we have the file on the server.
items.translation: 我看看，我想我们服务器上应该有那个文件。
chunks: I think we have the file on the server.
hints: 我想服务器上应该有那文件

grammar.meaning: 我想服务器上应该有这个文件

explanations: **let me see** = let me check「让我看看/让我查查」，回应对方需求前先确认的过渡语。
近义：let me think / let me check。例句：— What's the WiFi password? — Let me see... it's on the fridge.
distractors: I think we have the file on my desk.
I'm sure we have the file on the server.

sentenceAudio.text: Let me see — I think we have the file on the server.

items.sentence: I see — you're telling me you want to quit your job.
items.translation: 我明白了，你是告诉我你想辞职。
chunks: you're telling me you want to quit your job.
explanations: **I see** 是「我明白了/我懂了」，比 I understand 更口语。对方解释事情时的回应高频。
近义：got it / understood。例句：— It's a rental car, not ours. — I see, makes sense.
distractors: you're telling me you want to quit school.
you're telling me you want to keep your job.

sentenceAudio.text: I see — you're telling me you want to quit your job.

items.sentence: I get it — you don't want to talk about it right now.
items.translation: 我懂了，你现在不想聊这个。
chunks: you don't want to talk about it right now.
explanations: **I get it** 跟 I see 同意，但 get it 更有「完全理解/同感」意味，朋友间宽慰对方常用。
例句：— I'm so tired I could sleep for a week. — I get it. Take a break.
distractors: you don't want to talk about it tomorrow.
you want to talk about it right now.

sentenceAudio.text: I get it — you don't want to talk about it right now.

items.sentence: Not really — I just ate before I came over.
items.translation: 不怎么饿——我来之前刚吃过。
chunks: I just ate before I came over.
explanations: **not really** 表示「也不算/不太」，具体要看前文；这里结合刚吃过，意思是「不怎么饿」。
近义：I'm good / no thanks。例句：— Want more coffee? — Not really, but thanks.
distractors: I just ate before I came in.
I just ate before I went out.

sentenceAudio.text: Not really — I just ate before I came over.

items.sentence: We're leaving tomorrow — not yet tonight.
items.translation: 我们明天出发——今晚还不走。
explanations: **not yet** 表示「还没」，对 now? / ready? 这类当下问题的回答。
例句：— Are you packed for the trip? — Not yet, I'll do it in the morning.

sentenceAudio.text: We're leaving tomorrow — not yet tonight.

items.sentence: Not much, just catching up on some emails.
items.translation: 没什么，就是处理一下积压的邮件。
chunks: just catching up on some emails.
hints: 就是处理一下积压的邮件
explanations: **not much** 是 What's up / What's new 的标准回应：「没啥特别的」。**catch up on** = 补上落下的工作。
例句：— What are you up to? — Not much, just catching up on some paperwork.
distractors: just catching up on some sleep.
just catching up on some news.

sentenceAudio.text: Not much, just catching up on some emails.

items.sentence: It's now or never — grab the chance!
items.translation: 机不可失时不再来，抓住机会！
explanations: **now or never** 是「机不可失/要就要现在」，怂恿对方做决定的强力口号。
近义：seize the day。例句：Apply now — it's now or never!

sentenceAudio.text: It's now or never — grab the chance!

items.sentence: I have no idea where he went after the party.
items.translation: 我完全不知道派对后他去了哪。
chunks: where he went after the party.
explanations: **have no idea** 是「完全不知道」，比 don't know 语气更强（确实不知道而非不想说）。
近义：have no clue / haven't got a clue。例句：— Where's my passport? — No idea, have you checked your bag?
distractors: where he went before the party.
where she went after the party.

sentenceAudio.text: I have no idea where he went after the party.

items.sentence: I'm just kidding — don't take it seriously.
items.translation: 我开玩笑呢，别当真。
explanations: **just kidding** 是「开玩笑/逗你玩」，玩笑过头或朋友误会时立刻补充救场。
近义：just joking / I'm messing with you。例句：— You got fired? — Just kidding, I got a raise!

sentenceAudio.text: I'm just kidding — don't take it seriously.

items.sentence: Take your time — the deadline is next Friday, not today.
items.translation: 慢慢来，截止日期是下周五，不是今天。
explanations: **take your time** 是「慢慢来/不急」，给对方减压的友好表达，可用于工作/学习/约会/购物。
近义：no rush / there's no hurry。例句：Take your time choosing — these shoes are a big investment.

sentenceAudio.text: Take your time — the deadline is next Friday, not today.
